findings.reason: the same defect a prior review raised for §10/§11 recurs for §12; without naming §12 the newly declared section is undispatched and the followup misdirects the worker that reads it.
findings.text: f-araiid-007 is the only open followup; it recommends `/reckon-build a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline §8` and its body names §8, §10 and §11, describing §8 as "one walk per read, the audit included", yet §8 (line 143) now defers the audit to §12 which is freshly declared `implementable` (plan-section-declarations) and appears in no followup — so §12 has no dispatch route and the followup body contradicts §8's own text

findings.reason: the plan's stated invariant ("output unchanged", done-when "findings equal") cannot hold as written for a corpus containing invalid resource paths, and the temporary-corpus measure will not catch it because such a corpus need not contain one.
findings.text: §12's deliverable has `_audit` take its resources from `iter_resources` inside `resource_scan_scope` and states "The audit's output is unchanged", but `_audit` (reckon/mcp.py:2355-2359) currently emits `invalid-resource-path` findings from the `ResourceCollision` it catches on its own `identify_resource` loop; `_scan_resources` under `ignore_invalid=True` (the flag §8 requires of every in-scope caller) drops exactly those files silently, so routing the audit through `iter_resources` removes those findings

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §8 cites §10 and §12, §11 cites §5, §9 and §12, and §12 cites §7, §8 and §11, all of which resolve to sections that exist, and every symbol the changed units cite by name (`_scan_resources`, `iter_resources`, `resource_scan_scope`, `_SCAN_SCOPE`, `read_state_and_text_file`, `parse_plan`, `_parse_plan_uncached`, `_cached_plan_state`, `_audit`, `_audit_plan_state`, `_plan_html.from_html`) resolves in the tree at the reviewed revision.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of §8, §11 and §12 names a measurable count (walks, soup builds, findings equality) and a declared negative control that must fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §8, §11 and §12 log their negative controls under the run directory, a durable crew path, not a node-local scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed units name test files and functions by what they do; no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach them.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §12 requires `_audit` to take its resources from `iter_resources` inside a scan scope while asserting the audit's output is unchanged, but `iter_resources` with `ignore_invalid=True` (the flag §8 requires in scope) silently drops the invalid resources `_audit` reports.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8, §11 and §12 each name one deliverable; §12's walk and parse clauses are two facets of one goal (make the audit share the shared scan and parse) measured by one test.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the only open followup, f-araiid-007, names §8, §10 and §11 but not §12, which is freshly declared implementable and so has no dispatch route.
